title: Flavor manifest (flavor.json)
description: A setting (mod) is a directory under bridge/flavors/<id>/ with this manifest plus the files it overrides. Every field is optional except id. A flavor is standalone unless it names a parent with extends.

id.description: Must match the directory name. Hull and mission ids are namespaced <id>.<name> by convention.

extends.description: Flavor id to inherit from. Omit it (or set null) for a standalone setting that carries its own complete catalog.

units.description: Path (relative to the flavor directory) to a units.json document.

theme.description: Path to a CSS file overriding the :root theme block. Served after activity.css.

ships.description: Path to a ships.json document (hulls, art, defaults).

callsigns.description: Path to a callsigns.json document (name pools and naming style).

missions.description: Path to a mission JSON file or a directory of *.json mission documents.

defaultMission.description: Mission id used when a room names no mission. Defaults to the first mission.
